body: CI runs that suite on three hosted runners with no PHP, so an oracle section makes the runner *skip the whole case* there. Verify against PHP while authoring — `php -r '…'` is on `PATH` under Windows and inside WSL ([docs/setup.md](../../../setup.md)) — then drop the section or put the case in `tests/differential/`, where an oracle belongs; and a trailing space before a `\n` is unreliable in an `--EXPECT--` block, so echo a sentinel after it.
